use_when: 日历
日程管理
日历账户
事件管理
如何创建应用专属的日历账户
如何在日历账户下创建、删除、修改和查询日程
如何实现日程一键服务（DeepLink跳转）
如何注册并管理一键服务日程的跳转链接
如何实现会议一键入会、一键追剧、一键购物等场景
如何通过日程提醒通知引导用户跳转到应用
当你的应用需要将时间相关的服务（如出行、餐饮、运动、娱乐等）与系统日历集成时，可以使用Calendar Kit创建日历账户并管理日程，让用户在系统日历中查看和接收应用相关的日程提醒
当你希望为用户提供"一键服务"体验时（如会议一键入会、直播一键观看、还款一键跳转等），可以通过Calendar Kit的一键服务功能，将DeepLink写入日历日程，用户在日历通知或桌面卡片中直接点击服务按钮即可跳转到应用落地页
在系统日历里创建应用自己的日程源并同步活动安排 / Create an app-owned calendar source in the system Calendar and sync events
新增会议行程并设置开始结束时间、地点和备注 / Add meeting events with start/end time, location, and notes
读取某个时间范围内的日程列表并在应用中展示 / Load events in a time range and display them in the app
修改已创建的日程内容并更新提醒时间 / Update existing calendar events and change reminder times
删除取消的预约或活动避免继续提醒用户 / Delete canceled appointments or activities to stop further reminders
给订单、还款、出行计划写入系统日历并自动提醒 / Write orders, repayments, or travel plans into the system calendar with reminders
为直播、会议、观影等活动配置一键直达 DeepLink / Configure one-tap DeepLink entry for live streams, meetings, or movie sessions
从日历通知点击后直接跳转到应用详情页 / Jump from a calendar notification directly to an app detail page
管理日历账户下的事件增删改查 / Manage CRUD operations for events under a calendar account
给日程附加入会链接、观看链接或服务跳转链接 / Attach join links, watch links, or service links to calendar events
把用户报名成功后的活动自动加入手机日历 / Automatically add registered events to the user's phone calendar
接入 Calendar Kit 实现活动提醒和服务跳转联动 / Integrate Calendar Kit for event reminders and service deep-link navigation
do_not_use_when: 需求是识别或生成二维码、条形码，处理暗光、模糊、曲面码等复杂扫码场景；应改用 scan-kit / The task is to scan or generate QR codes and barcodes, including difficult cases like low light, blur, or curved codes; use scan-kit instead
需求是进行消耗型、非消耗型或订阅型数字商品购买，并处理应用内支付生命周期；应改用 iap-kit / The task is to sell consumable, non-consumable, or subscription digital goods and handle the in-app purchase lifecycle; use iap-kit instead
preconditions: 应用已在配置文件中声明日历读写权限（ohos.permission.READ_CALENDAR 和 ohos.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR） / The app has declared calendar read/write permissions in the config file (ohos.permission.READ_CALENDAR and ohos.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR)
用户已授予应用访问系统日历的权限 / The user has granted the app permission to access the system calendar
工程已集成并可使用 Calendar Kit 对应能力 / The project has integrated and can access the Calendar Kit capability
若使用日程一键服务，相关 DeepLink 跳转配置与服务端注册信息已准备完成 / If one-click calendar services are used, the related DeepLink configuration and server-side registration are already prepared
inputs: 日历账户信息 / calendar account information
日程数据（标题、开始时间、结束时间、提醒规则等） / event data (title, start time, end time, reminder rules, etc.)
日程标识或查询条件 / event identifier or query criteria
一键服务跳转链接或 DeepLink 信息 / one-click service link or DeepLink information
outputs: 应用专属日历账户对象及账户ID / App-specific calendar account object and account ID
日程事件对象及日程ID / Calendar event object and event ID
日程查询结果列表（按ID、标题或时间范围返回） / Calendar event query result list returned by ID, title, or time range
日程提醒配置与提醒时间 / Event reminder configuration and reminder time
系统日历中的日程提醒通知 / Calendar event reminder notification in the system Calendar
写入日程的一键服务DeepLink跳转信息 / One-click service DeepLink information written into a calendar event
日历通知、日历应用或桌面卡片中展示的一键服务按钮 / One-click service button shown in Calendar notifications, Calendar app, or home-screen cards
日历账户或日程的创建、更新、删除操作结果 / Create, update, and delete operation results for calendar accounts or events

postconditions.statement: 代码已接入 Calendar Kit 相关 API 以创建、查询、更新或删除日历账户或日程 / The code integrates Calendar Kit APIs to create, query, update, or delete calendar accounts or events
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set clearly add or modify code that calls Calendar Kit APIs for calendar account or event management?

postconditions.statement: 工程配置中包含日历读写权限声明 / The project configuration includes calendar read/write permission declarations
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, were READ_CALENDAR and WRITE_CALENDAR permissions added or confirmed in the app configuration?

postconditions.statement: 若实现一键服务，日程数据中已写入可拉起应用的 DeepLink 或对应跳转配置 / If one-click service is implemented, the event data includes a DeepLink or equivalent launch configuration
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the task involves one-click calendar service, do the edits show a DeepLink or equivalent jump configuration being attached to the calendar event flow?
